verdicts.evidence: The reason of a GREEN criterion becomes empty. MEASURED on the 28 cases: only the reason fields of the linked:true rows of the JSON change (\"linked\" -> \"\"); exit, verdict, counts, dangling, text, and every reason of the red rows identical; the text CLI never prints the reason of a linked row (guard `if (!cr.linked)`), human output byte-identical. On a green row there is no remediation to carry out and the machine flag is `linked`, not the string: ADR-0046's near-forbidden filing targets refusal reasons, all intact here. This is a degradation of a label in the JSON, not of a verdict or of a remediation.
